failed_or_insufficient_approaches: A fixed-bias Taylor expansion is unnecessary and nonuniform; exact homogeneity and the scalar k envelope replace it.
Dropping the negative near-region term loses the fixed-bias collision refund; equation (7) retains it.
The coarse separated envelope introduces M(a,b). Bounding M/q universally is not proved and is blocked by arbitrary-spectrum activation embeddings.
The fixed-source theorem cannot be applied unchanged when (a_v,b_v) varies coherently; that would recharge the reserve at every node.
